name: GR-598 Demo-First — 11 steps / 60 days
generatedFrom: Instantly benchmark data + product docs; see file header

steps.name: The reveal
steps.job: Link to their finished live site. No pitch, no price.

steps.name: Same-thread bump
steps.job: One specific detail noticed on their current site or listing.

steps.name: Price, unasked
steps.job: State $598 + $98/mo plainly. Removes the cost stall before it forms.

steps.name: Proof
steps.job: A comparable trade business, same metro where possible.

steps.name: First call
steps.job: Highest-value voice slot: four emails seen, price known, site exists.

steps.name: Loss frame
steps.job: What the current situation costs per month in missed calls.

steps.name: Objection pre-handle
steps.job: "Who maintains it", "I already have a guy", "I am too busy".

steps.name: Accuracy call
steps.job: Different pretext: is the demo still accurate? Genuinely useful, not a nag.

steps.name: The takeaway
steps.job: The demo comes down on a stated date. A REAL deadline, honoured.

steps.name: Final call
steps.job: Voicemail-safe. Assume no pickup and write for the machine.

steps.name: Breakup
steps.job: Permission to close the file. Historically the #2 reply step.

halts.on: stage in {Contract Signed, Live, Recurring Client}
halts.why: a dragged card may never flip status; emailing a signed client is the worst failure here
address is dead; further sends damage reputation
repeated soft bounces predict a hard one

halts.on: ANY reply from the same company domain
halts.action: halt all contacts at that domain
halts.why: NOT native to GHL — needs a company-domain custom field plus a tagging workflow
the asset the sequence is about no longer exists

guardrails.sendWindow: Tue-Thu, 9-11am or 1-3pm prospect local; launch Mondays; avoid Friday

abTesting.onlyTest: subject line and email-1 opening, on step 1 only — 58% of replies land there, and testing step 5 at this volume is statistically hopeless

math.note: From Instantly platform data, not their blog. 500 prospects through this sequence yields roughly 3 real conversations. The sequence is the easy part; the binding constraint is accurate, deliverable prospects at the top of it.

deliverabilityWarning: GHL has NO inbox rotation. Running cold volume here risks the domain that also sends invoices and contracts. Intended architecture: cold acquisition on dedicated throwaway domains in a rotation-capable tool; GHL owns everything post-reply.
